item.title: LOANED OUT | Conor Coady signs for Charlton Athletic on loan
item.description: Wrexham AFC can confirm that defender Conor Coady will join Charlton Athletic on loan until the end of the 2025/26 season. Coady, 32, has made six appearances in total so far this season, and now heads to South-East London for the remainder of the campaign. Nathan Jones’ side sit 19th in the Championship table, as the Addicks aim to secure their Championship status following promotion from League One last season. item.title: LOANED OUT | Paul Mullin heads to Bradford City
item.description: Wrexham AFC can confirm striker Paul Mullin has signed on loan for Bradford City until the end of the 2025/26 season. Back-to-back-to-back promotion winner Mullin, 31, started the season on loan with Wigan Athletic – scoring five goals. He returned to the Club in January, and will now spend the remainder of the season with Graham Alexander’s Bantams – who currently sit in the play-off places in League One. item.description: Tom Watkin's late headed goal secured Wrexham AFC Under-18s a valuable 1-1 draw away at Oldham Athletic. item.title: REPORT | Sheffield Wednesday 0-1 Wrexham AFC
item.description: Sam Smith’s sixth goal of the season proved the difference as Wrexham maintained their winning away form with victory at Hillsborough against Sheffield Wednesday. Smith slid in to break the deadlock in the second half – his fourth goal of a productive month for the striker. Wrexham largely controlled possession, but were grateful to an Arthur Okonkwo save and Matty James’ goal-line clearance to stay in front.
